    Doral, Fla. — Cushman & Wakefield has negotiated the sale of Doral Marketplace, an 83,365-square-foot, newly constructed retail center located in Doral, a western suburb of Miami. According to multiple sources, the property sold for $83 million. Whole Foods Market anchors the property, which was fully leased at the time of sale. Other tenants include Ulta Beauty, Shake Shack, J. Crew and Warby Parker.
Mark Gilbert, Adam Feinstein, and Mitchell Halpern of Cushman & Wakefield represented the seller, SJC Ventures, in the transaction. The buyer is a high-net-worth family office advised by Lincoln Property Co.
